correctness.rationale: Direct posterior covariance propagation gives J11=(1+a2^2)p2+q2, J12=p2+q1, J21=p1+q2, J22=(1+a1^2)p1+q1. For p1>=p2, greedy G=min(J11,J12) and O=min(G,J21) because J22>=J12. Comparing them gives strict regret iff p1-p2<min(q1-q2,a2^2 p2). If greedy is suboptimal, G/O<=(1+a2^2)p2+q2 over p1+q2 <=1+a2^2, with analogous relabeling. p1=1+delta,p2=1,q1=R+2,q2=delta attains limit 1+R as delta down to zero, R=max a_i^2>0. Independently regenerated 2500 rational schedule tables and exact greedy/optimum expressions, including 360 strict-regret samples. The boundary R=0 gives ratio one; positive process noise means supremum may not be attained.
